from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from llm_router import normalize_schema

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


class AliasedPayload(BaseModel):
    item_count: int = Field(alias="itemCount")


@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_STRUCTURED_SCHEMA_CONTRACT[revision==2]")
def test_pydantic_schema_preserves_field_alias_and_parses_alias_json() -> None:
    spec = normalize_schema(AliasedPayload)

    assert spec.model_type is AliasedPayload
    assert spec.json_schema == AliasedPayload.model_json_schema()
    assert "itemCount" in spec.json_schema["properties"]
    assert "item_count" not in spec.json_schema["properties"]

    rebuilt = spec.parse('{"itemCount": 42}')
    assert isinstance(rebuilt, AliasedPayload)
    assert rebuilt == AliasedPayload(itemCount=42)
